Hi Samir —

Thanks for sending the docs and the account details. A couple quick clarifying items so we can finish setup in our vendor portal and map remits correctly: 

1) Can you confirm the legal entity exactly as it should appear on the account (for payment verification / ACH match)? You wrote "Pioneer Supplies, Inc." but please confirm punctuation / DBA if any.
2) Confirm the receiving bank accepts micro-deposits for verification (yes/no) and typical clearing time.
3) Do you require any specific invoice reference in the remittance for automated reconciliation (e.g., must include PO number field labeled "PO" vs. free-text)? If you can paste a one-line sample remittance CSV mapping that would be helpful.
4) Bank letter looks good; could you also confirm an EDI or structured remit spec if you have one? If not, the sample line you sent is fine and we'll map to a single remit_desc field.

We will initiate a pair of small micro-deposits tonight from our ACH sandbox account and you should see them in 1-2 business days. Once the micro-deposits are verified we mark the account Active and add Redwood PO mapping.

I'll loop in Marissa from procurement on the PO requirements.

Thanks —
Naomi Feldman
Senior FinOps Specialist
Redwood Inference
naomi_feldman@redwood.com

From: Samir Patel <accounts@pioneer-supplies.com>

Hi Naomi,

Thanks — confirm the legal name is exactly: "Pioneer Supplies, Inc." (no DBA). Our bank accepts micro-deposits and typically posts within 24-48 hours; we will confirm once the amounts show and then reply with the verified amounts.

For reconciliation: we prefer the PO to appear as a discrete field labeled "PO" on the remit when possible. If Redwood's payout system only supports a single free-text remit field, please ensure the string includes "PO:PO-XXXX" so our AP parser picks it up. Example CSV row we consume: 

invoice_number, invoice_date, currency, amount, PO
INV-2026-0456,2026-11-30,USD,12450.00,PO-7219

We attached the same bank letter and W-9 again to this reply for convenience.

ETA: once micro-deposits post and are verified (1-2 business days) we can confirm and accept the first payment. If you need wire details instead, please confirm and we'll provide the wire authorization form.

Best,
Samir

Attachments: Pioneer_Bank_Letter.pdf, Pioneer_W9.pdf
